meddocan.title: MEDDOCAN
meddocan.subtitle: Spanish clinical de-identification (synthetic)
meddocan.why_we_include_it: Largest *public* Spanish clinical de-id corpus. Every Spanish clinical NLP paper cites it. Reviewer-credible. No DUA required.
meddocan.example:
Nombre: Ignacio.
Apellidos: Rico Pedroza.
NHC: 5467980.
Domicilio: Av. Beniarda, 13.
Localidad/ Provincia: Valencia.
Fecha de nacimiento: 11/02/1970...

asq_phi.title: ASQ-PHI
asq_phi.subtitle: Adversarial Synthetic Queries for clinical PHI (English)
asq_phi.phi_density: ~3.6 PHI elements per positive query, 2,973 across corpus
asq_phi.why_we_include_it: Built for exactly the Guardian-Layer use case: clinician-style queries that need PHI removal before going to external LLM/search tools. Includes 219 hard negatives that test over-redaction — a unique signal no other dataset gives us.
asq_phi.example: What is the latest treatment protocol for a 34-year-old female diagnosed with MS like Anna S., previously treated at Methodist Hospital on April 12, 2023?

pii_masking_300k.title: PII-Masking-300k
pii_masking_300k.subtitle: Multilingual general PII (synthetic)
pii_masking_300k.phi_density: varies — usernames, emails, addresses, names, etc.
pii_masking_300k.why_we_include_it: Widens the comparison beyond Spanish clinical to general English PII. Human-validated (~98% token label accuracy). Complements MEDDOCAN's narrow clinical focus.
